property_summary: For any fuzzed actor and delay, granting the actor PROPOSER_ROLE must let them schedule an operation (the role-gated entry succeeds); the mutant negates hasRole, so a legitimately granted actor is rejected and the call reverts.

For every role r, the admin role returned by getRoleAdmin(r) is itself governed by TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, i.e. getRoleAdmin(getRoleAdmin(r)) == TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE (the double-lookup is idempotent at the admin root); the mutant returns r itself, so the double lookup yields r instead of TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE for any role other than TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE.
